notes:
## New features & enhancements

- Three window sizes: Large, Medium and Small. The new button beside the pushpin steps through them, and Settings → Theme → Window size offers the same choice. The window shrinks to match. Until you choose, the radio opens at the largest size that fits your screen, so a small laptop screen gets Medium or Small.
- In the mini radio, a song title too long for its line now scrolls slowly along it, with a gap before it starts again, instead of being cut off.
- Station lists long enough to scroll now have a slide-pot scrollbar, a slider in a groove finished to match each theme, in place of the plain Windows bar.
- Model One theme: the play button and tone knobs are evenly spaced, their labels and readings sit centred under them, and the speaker’s centre cap sits truer.

## Bug fixes

- Song titles on Rogers stations (KiSS, CHFI and others) now appear closer to when the song starts, instead of some way into it.
- In the mini radio, the schedule countdown keeps its place at the end of the line instead of being pushed out of sight by a long song title.
- On Windows, the optional song-title helper now hangs up on each station at once, instead of leaving the connection open for about a minute and a half.
